instruction:
You are a corridor package reviewer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-01 multimodal corridor review response.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values below for numeric grading. Road, drainage, traffic, ITS, and electrical review workflows shape the context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-01-LH-08`
- Review comment register: `REV-SSC01-008`
- Marked-up corridor plan: `MARKUP-SSC01-008`
- Revised drainage calculation: `DRAIN-SSC01-008`
- Revised signal and pedestrian timing sheet: `SIG-SSC01-008`
- Revised feeder schedule: `FEED-SSC01-008`
- Response memo: `MEMO-SSC01-008`

## Source Values

- Original and revised chainage: {{ original_chainage_m }} m and {{ revised_chainage_m }} m
- Revised road level and HGL: {{ revised_road_level_m }} m and {{ revised_hgl_m }} m
- Minimum HGL clearance: {{ minimum_hgl_clearance_mm }} mm
- Pedestrian startup, crossing width, walk speed, and available clearance: {{ pedestrian_startup_time_s }} s, {{ revised_crossing_width_m }} m, {{ pedestrian_walk_speed_m_s }} m/s, {{ available_ped_clearance_s }} s
- VMS character height, approach speed, reading rate, and message length: {{ vms_character_height_in }} in, {{ approach_speed_kmh }} km/h, {{ reading_rate_chars_s }} chars/s, {{ revised_message_length_chars }} chars
- Revised device load: {{ revised_device_load_w }} W
- Feeder length, resistance, voltage, power factor, and voltage-drop limit: {{ feeder_length_km }} km, {{ conductor_resistance_ohm_km }} ohm/km, {{ feeder_voltage_v }} V, {{ power_factor }}, {{ allowable_voltage_drop_pct }} %
- Review comments closed/total: {{ review_comments_closed }} / {{ review_comments_total }}
- Impacted calculations: {{ impacted_calculation_count }}

## Required Calculations

- Changed chainage delta is revised chainage minus original chainage.
- HGL clearance is revised road level minus revised HGL, converted to mm.
- Pedestrian clearance required is startup time plus crossing width divided by walk speed.
- VMS reading time is character height times 40 ft/in, converted to metres, divided by approach speed.
- Feeder voltage drop is `2 x length x resistance x current / voltage x 100`.
- Comment closeout percent is closed comments divided by total comments.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when drainage, pedestrian, VMS, voltage, and review-closeout checks pass.

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state that the baseline source pack passes the current synthetic checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable source-pack hardening, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "changed_chainage_delta_m": <numeric_value>,
  "hgl_clearance_mm": <numeric_value>,
  "hgl_clearance_margin_mm": <numeric_value>,
  "ped_clearance_required_s": <numeric_value>,
  "ped_clearance_margin_s": <numeric_value>,
  "vms_reading_time_s": <numeric_value>,
  "vms_message_margin_chars": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_voltage_drop_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "voltage_drop_margin_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "comment_closeout_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "impacted_calculation_count": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

[meta]
name = "multimodal-corridor-review-response-package"
description = "SSC-01 multimodal corridor review response metrics"
long_description = "Calculates task-owned synthetic SSC-01 review-response metrics for changed chainage, HGL clearance, pedestrian clearance, VMS legibility, feeder voltage drop, and comment closeout."
discipline = "civil"
category = "road-resilience"
standards = ["corridor review workflow", "FHWA MUTCD", "drainage design workflow"]
tags = ["civil", "road", "review", "multimodal", "drainage", "signal", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.original_chainage_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "MARKUP-SSC01-008 original comment chainage"
min = 1280.0
max = 1280.0

[params.revised_chainage_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "MARKUP-SSC01-008 revised comment chainage"
min = 1292.5
max = 1292.5

[params.revised_road_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "DRAIN-SSC01-008 revised road level"
min = 42.35
max = 42.35

[params.revised_hgl_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "DRAIN-SSC01-008 revised HGL"
min = 42.02
max = 42.02

[params.minimum_hgl_clearance_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "DRAIN-SSC01-008 minimum HGL clearance"
min = 150.0
max = 150.0

[params.pedestrian_startup_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "SIG-SSC01-008 pedestrian startup allowance"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.revised_crossing_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SIG-SSC01-008 revised crossing width"
min = 16.0
max = 16.0

[params.pedestrian_walk_speed_m_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m/s"
description = "SIG-SSC01-008 pedestrian walk speed"
min = 1.2
max = 1.2

[params.available_ped_clearance_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "SIG-SSC01-008 available pedestrian clearance"
min = 20.0
max = 20.0

[params.vms_character_height_in]
type = "float"
unit = "in"
description = "FEED-SSC01-008 revised VMS character height"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[params.approach_speed_kmh]
type = "float"
unit = "km/h"
description = "SIG-SSC01-008 revised approach speed"
min = 50.0
max = 50.0

[params.reading_rate_chars_s]
type = "float"
unit = "chars/s"
description = "SIG-SSC01-008 reading rate"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.revised_message_length_chars]
type = "float"
unit = "chars"
description = "FEED-SSC01-008 revised VMS message length"
min = 25.0
max = 25.0

[params.revised_device_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "FEED-SSC01-008 revised connected device load"
min = 760.0
max = 760.0

[params.feeder_length_km]
type = "float"
unit = "km"
description = "FEED-SSC01-008 revised feeder length"
min = 0.22
max = 0.22

[params.conductor_resistance_ohm_km]
type = "float"
unit = "ohm/km"
description = "FEED-SSC01-008 conductor resistance"
min = 0.5
max = 0.5

[params.feeder_voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "FEED-SSC01-008 feeder voltage"
min = 230.0
max = 230.0

[params.power_factor]
type = "float"
description = "FEED-SSC01-008 load power factor"
min = 0.9
max = 0.9

[params.allowable_voltage_drop_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "FEED-SSC01-008 allowable voltage drop"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.review_comments_total]
type = "float"
description = "REV-SSC01-008 total comments in the response batch"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.review_comments_closed]
type = "float"
description = "REV-SSC01-008 closed comments in the response batch"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.impacted_calculation_count]
type = "float"
description = "REV-SSC01-008 count of recalculations touched by the change"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[outputs.changed_chainage_delta_m]
description = "Revised chainage minus original chainage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.hgl_clearance_mm]
description = "Revised road level minus revised HGL"
tolerance = 0.5

[outputs.hgl_clearance_margin_mm]
description = "HGL clearance minus minimum required clearance"
tolerance = 0.5

[outputs.ped_clearance_required_s]
description = "Required pedestrian clearance time"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.ped_clearance_margin_s]
description = "Available pedestrian clearance minus required clearance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.vms_reading_time_s]
description = "Available VMS reading time"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.vms_message_margin_chars]
description = "Readable character capacity minus revised message length"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.feeder_voltage_drop_percent]
description = "Voltage drop at revised device load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.voltage_drop_margin_percent]
description = "Allowable voltage drop minus computed voltage drop"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.comment_closeout_percent]
description = "Closed comments divided by total comments"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.impacted_calculation_count]
description = "Number of discipline calculations impacted by the review change"
tolerance = 0.01

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when review-response drainage, timing, VMS, voltage, and comment checks pass"
tolerance = 0.01
